icons.name: icon
icons.note: WAIVED — Selected-state check glyph 12×12 outer FRAME (#eabb62 disc + inner 9×9 icon-check + 1 white-VECTOR for the check mark). Impl ships a CSS-rendered View with borderBottom+borderLeft simulating the check, same primitive as button-master 458:2 and account-card-master 735:6822 precedents — the visible check stroke is geometrically equivalent to the figma authored vector. Approved 2026-05-28. (was: Figma icon has 1 vector path(s) but impl renders no <svg> here — likely a font-glyph/raster icon. Replace with a Figma SVG mark.)
